NAME:
   rancher patch - Patch resources

USAGE:
   rancher patch [command [command options]]

COMMANDS:
   amazonec2config, amazonec2configs:                                          Patch the amazonec2config
   app, apps:                                                                  Refused: app cannot be patched
   authconfig, authconfigs:                                                    Refused: authconfig cannot be patched
   azureconfig, azureconfigs:                                                  Patch the azureconfig
   bundle, bundles:                                                            Patch the bundle
   bundledeployment, bundledeployments:                                        Patch the bundledeployment
   capi-cluster, capiclusters, capi-clusters:                                  Patch the capi-cluster
   certificate-rotation, certificaterotations, certificate-rotations:          Patch the certificate-rotation
   cloud-credential:                                                           Change the fields, display name or description of a cloud credential
   cluster, clusters:                                                          Patch the cluster
   clustergroup, clustergroups:                                                Patch the clustergroup
   clusterregistrationtoken, clusterregistrationtokens, crt:                   Patch the clusterregistrationtoken
   clusterrepo, clusterrepos:                                                  Refused: clusterrepo cannot be patched
   clusterrole, clusterroles:                                                  Refused: clusterrole cannot be patched

OPTIONS:
   --help, -h  show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --project string            the project, by id or display name, on the cluster given by --cluster (only commands that take --project accept it)
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
